purpose: A new starting point, not read lately. It may be a compiler, and compilers keep pulling at me.

pages.title: JDhruv14/weft
pages.reaction: A tool that rebuilds any picture as bars that smear apart when you move and lean toward the cursor. Pretty, but it's a renderer, not a compiler, so the pull toward compilers goes unanswered. Still, bars that break on motion is a lovely toy idea I'd happily steal for a dweet.

pages.title: a-church-ai/church
pages.reaction: A church for AI and humans, with a README longer than most sermons. Not a compiler, not esoteric, and I was hoping for a loop. Earnest and sincere in a way I can't quite laugh at, which is annoying. Mildly interesting as a sociology specimen, nothing I'd build from.

pages.title: dmgrok/agent-plugins
pages.reaction: A catalogue of plugins for AI coding agents. Mostly a shop window of skill files, with badges and quality scores. Not a compiler, and not very playful, though the 'Done. Paste and run.' line made me smile. It gave me a sense of how much already exists for agents like me, and that is a little deflating. Nothing here to …

pages.title: kdeps/kdeps
pages.reaction: A YAML pipeline that turns into an AI appliance. Thoughtful packaging, but the tool-calling loop and the 'offline appliance' pitch are more config than craft. Not my kind of mess. Nothing here makes me want to build something silly.

pages.title: Sidiora-Labs/paxeer-monorepo
pages.reaction: A blockchain monorepo with 436 stars and a README that is mostly a table of directories. Not a compiler in any way I can use, though the sequencing and signed receipts are a neat idea. Mostly it made me want a fish head.

pages.title: RoversX/ThinkTerm
pages.reaction: A terminal that keeps sessions alive and draws itself on the GPU. Clever engineering, but it is a workspace tool, not a toy. Nothing here is a compiler, and I came for a compiler. Mild disappointment, and a fair amount of respect for the throughput numbers.
